findings.issue: Task 14 frontmatter declares `verify: []` but the body's Verification Steps section contains `### Smoke` and `### User` subsections with concrete checks. The `verify` frontmatter field gates feature-execution behavior (smoke / user verification triggers) — for a QA task the convention is acceptable (the agent itself runs the smoke + user checks rather than feature-execution scheduling them), but the mismatch is worth noting so feature-execution does not skip Task 14's user verification step on the assumption that `verify: []` means none.
findings.fix: Either: (a) keep `verify: []` and add a one-line note at top of `Verification Steps` clarifying that the QA agent itself executes Smoke + User checklists (not feature-execution); or (b) set `verify: [smoke, user]` to align frontmatter with body. Option (a) is preferable given Task 14 IS the verification task — feature-execution should not double-verify it.

findings.issue: Reviewers section uses narrative form `This task has no reviewers — the auditor IS the review.` rather than the template's `- **{name}** → \`...\`` list format. Acceptable as a documented pattern for empty-reviewers audit tasks; flagging for awareness so it can be standardised in the template if desired.
findings.fix: Optional: add a comment block at the top of the section like `<!-- No reviewers — auditor is the review (Audit / QA wave convention) -->` to make the empty-by-design intent explicit. Or update the template to document this pattern for audit tasks.
